relationships.subject: miR-135a
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-135a specifically binds to the 3′-UTR of ROCK1

relationships.subject: miR-140-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: the miR-140-5p has been also reported responsible for delayed senescence in human tendon stem/progenitor cells (TSPCs) by targeting peptidyl-prolyl cis/trans isomerase NIMA-interacting 1 (PIN1)

key_findings: Computational analysis selected miR-135 and miR-140 as combinatorial candidates for degenerative tendinopathy, acting via ROCK1 and PIN1 pathways.
miR-135 and miR-140 were predicted to regulate ROCK1, VEGF and TGF-beta.
